taxon_term.notes: Gram-negative deltaproteobacteria performing dissimilatory sulfate reduction in the vanadium tailings. Desulfovibrio oxidizes organic acids (lactate, pyruvate, formate) and hydrogen coupled to sulfate reduction, producing hydrogen sulfide (H₂S) that chemically reduces V(V) to V(IV) and precipitates vanadium as sulfide minerals.
